overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence check for the 5,500-tick milestone, and establishing the final ascension protocol for colonist psychology states. These steps ensure zero-deadlock stability and prepare the engine for v1.2.0 release.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::span<const uint8_t> for input. Implement FNV-1a 64-bit hash in constexpr context. No dynamic allocation. Handle endianness explicitly via std::endian::native. Provide static inline functions for hash combination. Ensure deterministic output across all platforms.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Hash of empty state is 0xcbf29ce484222325. 2. Hash of sequential integers 1..100 matches reference. 3. Zero heap allocations during hashing. 4. Compile-time evaluation supported for static states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save files are 100% reliable and load times are instant due to pre-computed validation.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check for Tick 5500
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a fixed-size circular buffer (std::array<float, 16>) for recent variance samples. Use Kahan summation for reduced floating-point error. Calculate convergence as variance < 1e-6 over last 16 samples. Return bool converged. No virtual functions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Convergence detected within 16 ticks of theoretical limit. 2. Memory footprint < 128 bytes per simulation instance. 3. No false positives in 10,000 test runs. 4. Execution time < 1 microsecond per tick.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation steps and more accurate endgame statistics display.

tasks.title: Finalize Colonist Psychology Ascension Protocol
tasks.architectural_spec: Define enum class AscensionState { Idle, Processing, Ascended }. Implement state machine with std::optional<AscensionState>. Use std::string_view for names. No dynamic strings. State transitions are atomic. Provide toString() for debug output.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. State transitions are deterministic. 2. No memory leaks in 10,000 cycles. 3. Debug output is human-readable. 4. Integration with StateHasher works correctly.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Clearer endgame status messages and smoother UI updates during ascension.
